privateZoneSeparate.note: Existing namespace zone, nonprorated. One October charge is included in full 24h repair scenario; do not add it again when combining elapsed and remaining views. If retained into November, second charge. Public tariff test deletion exemption under12h exists; retention to operative deadline exceeds12h.

excludedUnmeasured: ALB actual address count above minimum
NAT processed bytes including bootstrap downloads
S3 actual state versions/logs/backups and requests
